body:
sam: Quick follow-up from the storage-surge postmortem. We need runbook edits: a short triage checklist, canonical first-responder commands, explicit escalation ladder, and a "recurring-patterns" appendix with routing play. Who can pick these up?

elaine: I’ll own the triage checklist. Will make it a 6-step checklist with exact PromQL, which dashboards to open, and a single verification matrix. Target: 2026-04-02.

rohan: I can do the canonical commands and the canary script. Will include exact kubectl/log lines and a small GH Action for the canary. Target: 2026-04-05.

sam: I’ll take escalation ladder + alert owners. I want L1/L2/L3 mapped and backup contacts verified. Target: 2026-04-04.

oncall-bot: Linked postmortem: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/storage-surge-19611>. Actions recorded to INC-3247. Reminder set for 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC to review PRs.

elaine: Draft triage checks to include (will paste in PR):
1) confirm alert: AlertCacheEvictionHigh or AlertKVWarmSlow
2) check eviction rate: `sum(rate(cache_eviction_total[1m]))`
3) check KV warmup: `avg_over_time(kv_warmup_duration_seconds[5m])`
4) pod check: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o wide`
5) recent logs: `kubectl logs -n inference $POD --since=15m | egrep "evict|kv_warm|oom"`
6) if hit_rate < 0.7 run routing play

rohan: Commands I'll add to runbook (exact snippet):
```
POD=$(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl logs -n inference $POD --since=15m | egrep "evict|kv_warm|oom"
# quick promql checks
sum(rate(cache_eviction_total[1m]))
avg_over_time(kv_warmup_duration_seconds[5m])
```

rohan: Canary plan: GH Action that switches a small percent to smaller-context model, runs 3 smoke requests, and reports pass/fail. Will link in PR.

sam: Proposed temporary thresholds (I will vet): eviction_rate > 2/min for 3m; kv_warmup_duration_seconds > 12s for 5m; cache_hit_ratio < 0.7 for 5m. If approved we'll add as regression alerts.

elaine: I'll open PR for triage checklist and include routing play stub. INC-3247 will be referenced.

rohan: I'll open PR for commands + canary and reference INC-3247.

oncall-bot: Reminder: review PRs 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC.

sam: Summary (owner -> task -> due):
- elaine: triage checklist + routing play -> 2026-04-02
- sam: escalation ladder + alert owners -> 2026-04-04
- rohan: commands + canary PR -> 2026-04-05

elaine: :thumbsup:

rohan: :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks, this thread is the canonical action list. Ping here for blockers.
